Square plate about 24 cm. Mashed cauliflower or mashed potato portion about 120 g. Fried eggplant cubes about 100 g; fried eggplant absorbs oil, so around 150 kcal or more. If the mash is mashed potato, about 120 kcal; if cauliflower mash, less. Total about 220 g and 300 kcal.
